subject: Sponsor briefing: quiet-window preference, fallback plan & desk proxy
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@novapower.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor briefing: quiet-window preference, fallback plan & desk proxy

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for taking time to evaluate Redwood. Per our discovery call, you mentioned the CIO prefers a \"quiet window\" (no Q&A until after the exec overview) and an explicit fallback plan if their VP/CIO slot gets interrupted. We'd like to lock a 30‑minute executive intro + 30‑minute product run-through, with a short Q&A only if the CIO can stay. If not, we'll capture the full session and route questions asynchronously.

Options (all PT):
- Tue Oct 5, 10:30–11:30 — CIO morning window
- Wed Oct 6, 17:00–18:00 — late slot that usually works for their CIO
- Thu Oct 7, 14:00–15:00 — backup (VP might attend)

Can you confirm which slot is preferred and whether recording is acceptable? If the CIO needs to step out, we can nominate Ben Carter (VP of Solutions) as the desk proxy who will cover any customer questions and capture action items.

Attached is a short agenda and a run-of-show we use for quiet-window briefings. Also looping Kim to validate compliance/recording language.

Quick ask: if Novapower requires a non-recorded session for the exec portion, we can do a two-part meeting (exec only, non-recorded, then product run-through recorded with engineering). Let me know what works.

Thanks —
Elliot

Elliot Price
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0109
Attachment: 2026-10-01-redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@novapower.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@novapower.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing: quiet-window preference, fallback plan & desk proxy

Elliot —

Appreciate the clarity. CIO (Rajiv) prefers the quiet-window and wants the exec intro to be strictly 20 minutes with no recording for that portion — he is comfortable with a recorded product session afterward. He asked whether we can run the exec intro at 17:00 on Wed Oct 6 (we'll do exec intro 17:00–17:20, then product 17:25–17:55). That timing is tight because his travel schedule changes daily; Rajiv asked that if he drops, the VP (Asha) should continue and that your team capture action items.

Two notes:
1) We need a short mutual action plan at the end with owners (can be in the recording).
2) Can you confirm who will be the desk proxy if Rajiv hops? Ben was mentioned — is he prepared to cover the product Q&A too?

Thanks,
Asha

Asha Kumar
Director, Strategic Programs — Novapower
asha.kumar@novapower.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@novapower.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing: quiet-window preference, fallback plan & desk proxy

Thanks Asha — quick operational notes from Redwood Ops: 

- Ben can absolutely act as the desk proxy and will cover product Q&A. He'll be pre-briefed and will have the slide deck + runbook.
- For the exec intro we will run a 20‑minute no-record segment. After that, we will stop recording and then start a new recording for the product run-through (we'll keep the naming convention: Novapower_product_20261006.mp4).
- Kimberly: can you confirm if we need a redlined recording consent form or if the standard MSA/recording clause is sufficient? If Novapower requires an additional doc, we can send an NDA amendment; otherwise, recording consent in the calendar invite will suffice.

Action items: 
- Elliot: add Ben as alternative presenter and include his slide notes.
- Marissa: prepare a 2‑slide executive summary tailored to Novapower’s cost/latency concerns.
- Kim: confirm recording consent requirement by EOD.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Novapower-privacy-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)
From: Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@novapower.com>

Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@novapower.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing: quiet-window preference, fallback plan & desk proxy

Hi all —

Small update from Rajiv's side: his flight was moved up and there's a 60% chance he won't be onsite for Wed evening. He asked that we keep the 17:00 start but run the exec intro even if he isn't present; he'll watch the exec summary off the recording and follow up asynchronously. If Rajiv cannot attend in real time, he still wants the intro kept off the record (we will not record the first 20 minutes).

Please proceed with Ben as the on-call desk proxy and record the product session only. Also, can you add a 5‑minute mutual action plan at the end of the product session so it is captured?

Thanks —
Asha
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@novapower.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing: quiet-window preference, fallback plan & desk proxy

Asha —

Perfect, thanks for the heads up. Confirming final run-of-show for Wed Oct 6 (PT):
- 17:00–17:20 Exec intro (no recording) — presenters: Elliot (opening), Marissa (exec summary).
- 17:25–17:55 Product run-through (recorded) — presenter: Ben (Q&A owner).
- 17:55–18:00 Mutual action plan & owners (recorded).

I've attached the calendar invite (will send from my calendar after this thread). Ben — please confirm you'll join the dry run on Tue Oct 5 at 11:00 PT so we can rehearse the handoff if Rajiv drops.

Kimberly: if you can confirm by EOD Monday whether Novapower requires an additional consent doc, we'll update the invite language. Otherwise, I'll include the recording consent text in the invite: "Product session will be recorded for internal purposes; exec intro will not be recorded."

Thanks team — looking forward to it.

Elliot
